subject: Swap risk matrix & proposed experiments to validate OpenAI-API parity
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moran <alex.moran@acme.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call notes + proposed experiments (hyperscaler delta / API parity)

Alex — thanks again for a great call earlier. Short recap and proposed next steps so we can operationalize the evaluation you asked for: 

1) What we heard: Acme is prioritizing predictable inference latency and minimal prompt deltas while moving away from CloudPrime-managed endpoints. Key blockers: tokenization/response differences, SDK swap effort, and procurement timelines.

2) Immediate hypothesis: most functional deltas between Redwood and CloudPrime are surface/parameters (temperature, stop sequences, tokenization) — not model capability. Where you're likely to see user-facing regressions is in long-context summarization and structured JSON output.

3) Proposed experiments (we can own 1–3):
  - Run an SDK-swap smoke test: replace CloudPrime client with Redwood SDK on two representative services (search + helpdesk triage).
  - Prompt-diff bench: 1000 sample prompts from production, compare tokenization, top-k/top-p effects, and output diffs (automated similarity metric + human triage for regressions).
  - Latency stress sweep: single-region TB test at 95th & 99th percentiles for your p95 SLO.

I attached a short "swap-risk-matrix.xlsx" that maps risk areas to mitigations and estimated engineering days. Also linking a one-page interop test plan: https://drive.redwood.ai/ACME/interop-test-plan

Next actions I propose: please confirm a small list of sample prompts and two services for the SDK swap; Ben will own the test harness and produce a delta report within 5 business days once you give samples.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachment: swap-risk-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alex Moran <alex.moran@acme.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Talya Reed <talya@cloudprime.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call notes + proposed experiments (hyperscaler delta / API parity)

Kimberly — useful summary, thanks. Quick clarifications: 

- For the SDK swap, our two services will be: 1) Support ticket classifier (short prompts ~120 tokens) and 2) Weekly document summarizer (long context ~6k tokens). We can share prompt samples and a tiny sandbox dataset.
- On latency: p95 requirement is <= 450ms for the classifier (95th), and the summarizer is less strict (~1.5s p95) but sensitive at p99.
- We have a compliance question: will logs/token data for this POC be stored outside our account? We prefer no long-term retention.

Availability: I can share sample prompts and a sandbox S3 link by Monday. Talya from CloudPrime is looping in case there are contract overlap items; she doesn't need to attend but is keeping us honest.

—Alex
Alex Moran
Senior Platform Engineer, Acme Corp
alex.moran@acme.io

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Moran <alex.moran@acme.io>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call notes + proposed experiments (hyperscaler delta / API parity)

Adding a practical plan and a risk matrix for the POC. I drafted the attached swap-risk-matrix.xlsx and a short interop-test-plan.md that lists the concrete tests we'll run. Highlights: 

- SDK-swap sanity (2 dev days): validate auth, streaming, and error surface parity with a small harness. Expects ~10 lines of code change per service.
- Prompt-diff batch (automated + human): run 1k prompts through CloudPrime and Redwood, compute tokenization diffs, BLEU-ish similarity, and surface 30 highest delta candidates for manual review. (3 eng days + 8 hours of annotation.)
- Long-context regression test: run 200 long-doc summarizations; check hallucination rate and JSON schema conformance. (2 eng days)

Risks & mitigations:
- Tokenization mismatch: mitigation = prefix normalization layer + explicit tokenizers; rollback: route heavy summarization traffic to CloudPrime while we tune.
- Latency spikes during cold-cache: mitigation = warmup sequences + KV caching.

I'll own the harness and can start once Alex shares the sample prompts and S3 link. Kimberly — do you want me to set up a short demo of the harness next Tuesday?

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: interop-test-plan.md (text/markdown)

2) Data retention: for the POC we will not retain prompt/response payloads beyond the test window; Ben will spin a temporary test project that purges logs after 7 days. I'll confirm the purge policy in writing before any data is ingested.
3) Demo of harness: Ben — please schedule a 30-minute walkthrough for Tue (10–11am PT); Marissa, please include a short readiness checklist from Product so we don't miss edge cases (e.g., stop-sequence handling / streaming truncation).
